subdeck: Nvidia surges 31.3% on Jensen Huang's return · Ukraine hits Perm refinery & claims Libya strike · Belgian ATC strike halts flights

heroes.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; stock surges 31.3%
heroes.summary: Board votes unanimously 11 days after his exit; Nvidia says US officials confirmed no security risk. NVDA closes at $164.88; S&P 500 jumps 4.73% (7,237) and Nasdaq +6.5%.

heroes.headline: Ukraine hits Perm & Novoshakhtinsk refineries, claims Libya strike
heroes.summary: Long-range drones strike Lukoil's Perm plant (>1,500 km deep) and Novoshakhtinsk; Zelenskyy claims Sunday's Benghazi drone attack as eastern Libya appeals to the UN.

heroes.headline: General strike shuts Belgian air traffic control, grounds flights
heroes.summary: Operator skeyes halts services 07:00–21:00 in nationwide anti-austerity walkout, cancelling nearly all Brussels Airport flights as PM De Wever faces budget deadlock.

features.headline: Supreme Court grants amnesty to Puigdemont
features.summary: Ruling closes 2017 Catalan case, clearing the last legal barrier to his return after ~9 years in exile.

features.headline: UK recognises Rohingya genocide, sanctions 5 generals
features.summary: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announces recognition and Myanmar military sanctions in the Commons.

features.headline: NASA seeks partners for first lunar nuclear reactor
features.summary: Agency issues RFP for Lunar Reactor-1 (LR-1), a 20-kW fission system targeted for launch by 2030.

features.headline: Kospi falls 3.3% (low -5.8%); Taiwan curbs short sales
features.summary: Asian chip stocks drop before Wall St rally; Taiwan bans shorting below prior close & sets 150% margin.

features.headline: NHS launches world's largest AI breast-cancer trial
features.summary: £10m EDITH study enrols nearly 700,000 women across 30 sites to test AI-assisted mammogram reading.

features.headline: FIFA ratifies 2031 & 2035 Women's World Cup hosts
features.summary: US, Mexico, Costa Rica & Jamaica host 48-team 2031 edition; UK stages 2035, its first Cup since 1966.

features.headline: Search underway after migrant boat capsizes off Senegal
features.summary: Rescue teams recover bodies off Yenne south of Dakar after a pirogue carrying ~50–100 migrants overturns.

features.headline: New Zealand bat out Day 5 to draw 1st Test vs India
features.summary: Daryl Mitchell (49*) and Glenn Phillips (26*) guide hosts to 239-5 off 120 overs in Wellington.

briefs.text: Von der Leyen unveils 22nd Russia sanctions package proposing bans on Russian teams and flags at EU sports events.
Hundreds of schools receive 'Death awaits you' email bomb threats; police assess as coordinated hybrid hoax.
EU Commission confirms EU Academy user data breach in AI-driven cyberattacks; member states clash on 2028–34 budget.
58-year-old student dies at Sapienza University while on hunger strike over student housing shortages.
Cyber agency BSI elevates IT threat level to critical, warning of autonomous agentic AI attacks.
German President Steinmeier opens 3-nation Africa tour — first German head of state in Côte d'Ivoire in 43 years.
South Africa's Deputy President Mashatile opens 2nd AWSISA Africa & Global South Water Dialogue.
WFP warns UN Security Council of a 'triple chokepoint' in global trade deepening famine risk in Sudan and Somalia.
Eastern govt files UNSC complaint & UNSMIL condemns Benghazi strike; Sharara oil pipeline reopens.
CREA reports 9 African oil exporters gained $21.6bn windfall; Nigeria's Tinubu urges decriminalising suicide attempts.
PM Modi and visiting Nepal PM Balendra Shah hold bilateral talks and launch the Ayodhya–Janakpur train.
ICC presidency formally acknowledges and regrets Tajikistan's Rome Statute withdrawal notice (effective Nov 2027).
Confirmed death toll from Saturday's PT Fonusa Agung Mulia sweets factory fire reaches 24; dozens unaccounted for.
Rival BNP clashes in Jhenaidah hurt 15+; Awami League clashes in Gopalganj hurt 20+ with four crude bombs.
Stone-laden truck overturns onto a minitruck, killing seven people and injuring two.
Lowy 2026 Asia Power Index keeps India 3rd (tightest China gap since 2018); govt weighs 30% non-Basmati rice duty.
Reports say China's 4th, nuclear-powered carrier nears completion; HK restricts Tai Po fire anniversary memorials.
Designated PM Eisenkot tells lawmakers no immediate Iran threat requires a strike before a government forms.
Haaretz reports 23 soldier and police suicides in 2026 — the highest annual toll in 16 years.
Turkish security sources publicly report PKK withdrew from 14 more Hakurk bases under peace process.
UAE condemns Somalia's Sunday envoy expulsion as 'hostile'; Qatar's PM warns against renewed US–Iran escalation.
US Central Command denies Iranian claims a US F-16 was targeted over the Gulf; 10-year Treasury yield nears 4.97%.
Trump says he will defer to 8th Circuit appeals court on the Army's disputed 60-barrel lead-azide detonation.
Coastal storms, El Niño ocean warmth and 20-year king tides threaten Thanksgiving-week coastal flooding.
Save the Children warns of a sharp malaria spike threatening children in the August M7.4 quake zone.
ICE detains Princeton neuroscience researcher at Reagan National; US EDA awards $39m disaster infrastructure aid.
Australian music journalist and Countdown icon Ian 'Molly' Meldrum dies aged 83; state funeral planned.
Australia flash services PMI drops to 46.2 (5-year low); New Zealand formally joins NATO's airworthiness pact.
Bitcoin rebounds near $62,000 and spot gold tops $3,615/oz (+2%) while Brent crude eases to $88–91/bbl.

date_check_text: Earlier days excluded (UTC) — Sun 22 Nov: COP31 no-deal breakdown, Benghazi corvette sinking (Ukraine's claim shown today), 186-drone barrage & Dymer strike, Khartoum UN raid, Ituri Ebola clinic clash, Netanyahu–Eisenkot talks, Co-op Live evacuation, Dhaka highway clash, Sea-Tac ICE arrest, Las Vegas GP, ATP Finals, HK poll, Trump Iran interview, Somalia envoy expulsion. Sat 21 Nov: BepiColombo burn, El Chapo Isidro, Sparta II fire. Not yet: World Chess Game 1 (Tue 24), 2nd NZ–India Test (Fri 27).
